# Safetec Direct

> UK supplier of workplace safety equipment, PPE, workwear, and safety signage featuring brands like Portwest, JSP, and Uneek with custom logo services.

Safetec Direct provides comprehensive industrial safety solutions including personal protective equipment (PPE), hi-visibility workwear, safety signs, first aid supplies, and branded workwear customization. The company specializes in British Standard compliant safety products for construction, manufacturing, and general workplace environments.

## Key Topics

- Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
- Portwest Workwear
- JSP Safety Products
- Hi-Visibility Clothing
- Hearing Protection
- Respiratory Protection
- Safety Signage
- Flame Retardant Workwear
- Custom Logo Service
- British Standard Compliance
- Industrial Safety
- First Aid Equipment
- Breathable Workwear
- COSHH Compliance

## Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)

- [JSP Head Protection](https://www.safetecdirect.co.uk/jsp-head-protection): JSP EVO safety helmets, hard hats & bump caps with custom logo service
- [Dust Masks](https://www.safetecdirect.co.uk/ppe-personal-protective-equipment/respiratory-protection/disposable-masks): FFP1, FFP2 & FFP3 disposable respiratory protection masks
- [JSP Ear Defenders](https://www.safetecdirect.co.uk/jsp-ear-defenders): JSP Sonis ear defenders & hearing protection for industrial safety
- [JSP Hard Hat Ear Defenders](https://www.safetecdirect.co.uk/jsp-hard-hat-ear-defenders): JSP Sonis helmet-mounted ear defenders for construction safety
- [Ear Defenders | Ear Muffs](https://www.safetecdirect.co.uk/ppe-personal-protective-equipment/hearing-protection/ear-defenders): Portwest & JSP ear defenders providing low to high level hearing protection

## Hi-Visibility & Specialist Workwear

- [Portwest Hi Vis Trousers & Shorts](https://www.safetecdirect.co.uk/portwest-hi-vis-trousers-shorts): Portwest hi-vis trousers & shorts with custom logo service available
- [Anti Static Hi Vis Workwear](https://www.safetecdirect.co.uk/hi-vis/hi-vis-type/anti-static-hi-vis): Portwest Modaflame anti-static flame resistant hi-vis workwear
- [Flame Retardant Overalls](https://www.safetecdirect.co.uk/workwear/work-overalls-bib-and-brace/flame-retardant-overalls): Portwest Bizweld & Bizflame flame resistant coveralls with custom logos
- [Breathable Clothing](https://www.safetecdirect.co.uk/breathable-clothing): Breathable workwear including Portwest & Uneek softshell jackets & shirts
- [Portwest PW3](https://www.safetecdirect.co.uk/brands/portwest-pw3): Portwest PW3 performance workwear & safety apparel brand page

## Safety Signage & Labeling

- [British Standard Fire Exit Signs](https://www.safetecdirect.co.uk/safety-signs-labels/healthsafety/britishstandardfireexitsigns): British Standard compliant fire exit & emergency directional signs
- [COSHH Hazchem Labels on Roll](https://www.safetecdirect.co.uk/safety-signs-labels/tapes-labelsandfloormarking/labels,coshhhazchemrolls): Hazchem & COSHH compliant chemical safety warning labels on rolls
- [Glass Awareness Signs](https://www.safetecdirect.co.uk/safety-signs-labels/tapes-labelsandfloormarking/glassawareness): Glass door awareness signs & automatic door marking products
- [Clearview Prestige Signs](https://www.safetecdirect.co.uk/safety-signs-labels/specialist-safety-signs/clearviewprestige): Clearview Prestige 6mm specialist facility & toilet safety signs

## Workwear Accessories & Hand Protection

- [Knitted Work Gloves](https://www.safetecdirect.co.uk/knitted-gloves): Regatta knitted work gloves including thermal & fingerless styles
- [Aprons | Tabards](https://www.safetecdirect.co.uk/workwear/workwear-accessories/aprons-tabards): Protective aprons & tabards including cut-resistant & disposable types
- [Armbands | Arm Badge Holders](https://www.safetecdirect.co.uk/workwear/workwear-accessories/armbands-arm-badge-holders): Hi-vis armbands & badge holders for first aiders & fire marshals

## First Aid & Workplace Safety

- [Plasters & Dressings](https://www.safetecdirect.co.uk/first-aid/first-aid-essentials/plasters-dressings): HypaPlast washproof plasters & wound dressings for first aid
- [Accident Reporting](https://www.safetecdirect.co.uk/first-aid/first-aid-equipment/accident-reporting): Accident report books & near miss record books for workplace safety
